This indicates that the web-parsing and navigation was not performed adequately, leading to repeated scrolling without extracting definitive information, effectively causing the search process to stall. This aligns with the repetitive and unproductive navigation error patterns seen in Example 9. Consequently, this failure cascaded into an incorrect final answer driven by inadequate data retrieval from the key source.
